selection.discovery_queues: Nominate six consistent plus two rare AB conditions, at most one level per pair; validate both single arms at the same level.
selection.final_queues: Nominate four consistent plus two rare AB conditions, at most one level per pair; test both single arms at the same level.

protocol.scope: Shared prompt templates across partitions are disclosed. Exact prompt strings are disjoint from the parent, initial confirmation and other stages. These finite tasks do not establish out-of-distribution generalization. Separate raters see frozen descriptions without validation scores or notes. Task loss, baseline defects, repetition, collapse, rare effects and random matches are separate from the stability decision.

candidate_provenance.rule: Force L2 N3420 +9x and two coordinates from layers with edited W2; fill by validation nominations. Reserve their late/late pair, then sample fifteen other pairs with the fixed seed. Parent-validation L10 N4198 +3 and L14 N1700 -3 may backfill; they are not claimed stable.
candidate_provenance.fallback_scope: L1 N0 and L8 N0 are deterministic uncharacterized backfills, not claimed discoveries.

protocol.factorial_interpretation: All three final arms are assessed against the frozen AB description, without earlier scores. Only AB is eligible as a pair discovery; single arms are controls. AB-versus-single differences alone are not evidence of synergy because perturbation magnitudes differ. Four random controls match aggregate within-projection write magnitude; local norms are not net cross-layer norms.

decoding: Greedy BF16 native LFM with original tokenizer/configuration, no weight updates. Every physical batch has an untouched anchor. OOM splits retain anchors. Checkpoint aliases are blinded to reviewers; frozen descriptions contain no previous scores or notes.
